verdict.rationale: Scheduled or automatic actions are a fair question for an online tax service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows HMRC offering user-configurable automations that run in the background. The MTD API platform and compatible third-party software are developer building blocks and external tools, and email subscriptions are an adjacent notification feature, so none of these counts as an HMRC automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
